: Wow, Aki-kun. You look super drained all of a sudden. Want to rest your head on my shoulder?
: He’s probably just exhausted from all the sex you made him have with Makoto.
: Ami, shh!

: How many times do I have to warn you to not talk about that when there are others around? Daddy could get into a lot of trouble if people find out he’s conducting socially unacceptable acts with your friends.
: But when is he going to conduct socially unaccepetable acts with me?! I’m tired of just watching!
: He just loves you way too much to do that kind of stuff with you, my little lightning bug.
: But he loves you too and you get to do it all the time...
: That’s because he loves me romantically. And also because he has built an unbreakable dependency on my body over our long, joyous life together.
: Fine...But I am not happy about this.
: I guess you get to join your father then since he seems dead set on sulking for the rest of the night.
: Aki-kuuuuuun! It’s time to eat your dinner~
: Or perhaps you’d like another helping of me instead?
: You haven’t seen Makoto ever since that...thing happened, have you?
: No. But we don’t have to use her again. If you really want a second girl, Rin looks cute today. Want me to go work my magic for you and get her pants off?
: I’m not talking about sex. I was just kind of mean to her and I feel like I should probably apologize.
: For what? She loves being talked down to. You saw firsthand how into it she got when I was flexing on her back in the sex room.
: Mom, maybe we should leave Daddy alone for a few minutes? The doctor says we’re not supposed to press him when he gets like this.
: Was I happy?
: Hm?
: Probably not if there’s some kind of “doctor” involved.
: I just wanted to know if I turned out okay with a life like this. A wife. A daughter. A job. And presumably still an unhealthy amount of sex with teenage girls.
: Define “unhealthy” because I actually think all of that exercise is the main reason you’re still in shape.
: You seem happy to me, Dad. At least most of the time.
: Sometimes...it feels like there’s nothing I can do for you, though. And even if I know now that some brains are just built like that, it still makes me sad seeing you that way.
: Well said, Ami.
: Let me ask you this, Akira — do you see this beautiful girl we made? Do you really think you could ever be unhappy with her by your side?
: Even if you’re a time-traveler who comes from a world where I’m dead, Ami’s still there, isnt she? And there’s no way she would ever fall out of love with you.
: So it doesn’t matter whether or not I stick around when I’ve given you the best gift a woman can give no matter what timeline you come from.

: Unless there’s some bonus timeline I don’t know about where I’m born infertile and am thus incapable of harboring any children. If there’s a world like that where I’m also dead, that probably sucks for you.
: But also probably not because then you could do it inside as many times as you want and I’d never get pregnant!
: Awww...But that would mean you could do it inside as many times as you want and I’d never get pregnant...
: I’m surprised you two haven’t made me a sister yet if that’s your outlook on sex.
: Do you really want one? Because I’m totally not into the idea of popping another kid out. But if my little girl is feeling lonely, I’ll certainly think about it.
: Hm? Oh, no. I’m fine with being an only child. I have you two to keep me company, and then Ayane and Sana when neither of you are around. I was just poking a little fun at you.
: Oh, you little kidder, you! No more joking about siblings, though. It’s a sore spot for your father.
: Hahaheheh! Mom, stop it! You’re gonna embarrass me in front of all of my friends!
: Oooooh? Well, if booping you is too embarrassing...looks like I’ll just have to tickle you instead! Come here, lightning bug!
: AhahahAahHahahah! Stop it! Oh my god! Aaaaaah! Moooooom!
Maybe I will stay here.
Maybe I can trick myself into believing this isn’t temporary when I knew within the first few minutes it would be.
What’s that? You want to know how I knew? Easy. One of my wishes came true. In fact, several of my wishes came true.
But even though I can be immersed in them here in a manner far different from what I see and feel on that bed in an endless ocean, it’s exactly like you’d expect.
Too good to be true.
Apart from the fact that Maya doesn’t exist here, but...in a depressing and hard-to-admit way, that’s good too.
It makes all of her suffering for nothing, sure. But...
I think she’d choose that over endless torment without any hesitation at all.
I know I would.
And even if moments like this make it feel worth it, the amount of time I’ll be able to drown myself in that feeling is but one tick of the second-hand on a clock with infinite hours.
: You really want me to stay, Sekai?
: Hm? Stay where? What are you talking about, Dad?
: Something he and I were discussing earlier, Ami. You don’t need to worry about it. And yes, Aki-kun. I do.
: But why? Don’t you feel guilty at all about just casting aside the me you’ve been with this entire time?
: Why would I feel guilty about that? They’re all you.
: You look the same and smell the same. You feel the same things. And yeah, memories are nice to have, but they aren’t everything, Aki-kun. My love isn’t tied to something silly like that.
: I love you because you’re you. And because you love me. It’s that simple. And all you’re going to do by questioning that is break yourself down.
: It’s not your fault you were sent somewhere you aren’t meant to be. So why should you be punished for that when this you loves me just as much as the old one?
: Of course I want you to stay. I’ll take you no matter which you it is, because I know you’d do the same for me.
: The main difference is that you’re stubborn, though. So it might just take you a little while to accept it.

: I’m really confused by whatever’s going on right now, but I’m with Mom. It doesn’t matter when or where you’re from — just who you are. And all it takes is one look at you to know you’re the same Daddy I’ve always had.

: Now, is there anything else I can say to mend your blistered heart? Any additional compliments you’re craving or reassurance needed so you can trick yourself into believing that someone out there accepts you?
: Can you reassure me that this is real and that it’s not going to just be taken away from me out of nowhere again?
: Because it might sound a little corny, but losing you again is going to hurt just as much as the first time.
: Well, that’s not true at all. Nothing will ever measure up to that first time. You know that. And in terms of assuring you that this is real? Whoo boy. Don’t even get me started.
: Oh boy...here we go again...
: To answer that question — we must first define what “real” is. For, you see-
: Time is just a construct. Perception shapes the world around us. There is no way to prove the existence of God or the idea that life itself is or is not a simulation. Blah, blah, blah. Let’s eat.

: Noooooo! You totally paraphrased my philosophical rant! And made it way less interesting in the process! Now Aki-kun is going to come up with his own ideas and probably get sent to a different afterlife!
: Do you even believe in an afterlife, Mom? I thought you said the other day that you weren’t sure?
: I’m not. That was just a joke. Which you have also now ruined by forcing me to address it. Bad, Ami. Go to the sex room and repent.
: Only if I can take Daddy there.
: Ready to screw your daughter, big guy?
: Please?
: Definitely not in this timeline...In the event that I’m gone soon, I want to leave things as perfect as they were when I got here.
: Well, I hope you’ve got at least one more round in you, dearest husband.
: Because one of my students is on her way here as we speak. And she sounded like she really wanted it today if you know what I’m saying.
: ...What?
: So you’re...still teaching as well?
: Oh, right. This Aki-kun wouldn’t know. I’m an English teacher at Kumon-mi Academy and-
: Oh, look! There she is now!
: Nodoka! We’re over here! Come sit! This roast is to die for!
: You’re going to love this girl, Aki-kun. She’s not only a genius, but a total freak. Like, I’m talking Lovecraftian-
: I already know her...
: Nodoka?! What are you doing here?! If I had known you were coming, I would have-
: I have to finish...
: Naming my child...
: ...What?
: Damn. She’s even weirder than you made her sound, Futaba. And that’s saying a lot since you made her sound really fucking weird.
: Yeah...she’s like that sometimes.
: Wait- how do you two know each other, Aki-kun? Nodoka’s never even mentioned you-
: From my world...not this one...
: Oooooh. Yeah, that makes more sense then. Boo! There goes the surprise...
: Which one are you?...
: ...What?
: I’m never sure anymore...
: Did you...come here at the same time as me?...
: I don’t...
: I can’t remember...
: How long it’s been...
: Then...how am I supposed to prove who I am?...
: Will you...
: Ask me about birds?...
: What do you know...
: About the white-fronted parrot?
: I failed...
: Failed what?...
: Everything...
: Nodoka-
: Please...
: May I hold you for just a moment?...
: Yes...
: I never did this back home.
: I wonder why?...
: Do you...
: Want to go outside?...
: There’s no point.
: To any of this.
: I can’t figure it out.
: But I know now, Akira...
: She isn’t crazy.
: She’s scared.
: Are you scared too?...
: Because I was...
: But I’m not anymore.
: The color...
: It’s here again...
: And more beautiful than ever before...
: Oooookay. This is officially weird now.
: I need you to listen to three things.
: First, stay away from the roof of the school. And do not, under any circumstances, attempt to leave Kumon-mi.
: Second, do not let me continue my research. You must convince me to stop. But it will not be easy. You’ll likely have to force me. But that’s okay. I’ll only pretend to dislike it.
: And third...
: You’re going to need a new shirt.
: What?
: Hm? Ami? Is something-
: Nodoka?...
: Ami, no! What are you doing?! Stop!
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!
: Yo, what the fuck?! Everybody, book it! Chika, come on!
: Holy shit! Rin! Futaba! What are you waiting for?! We’ve gotta get out of here! I’ll call an-
: Molly’s still not here! And Futaba won’t move! I-I-I-I don’t know what to do!
: I’ll find them! Miku, call an ambulance!
: Aaaaaaah...
: Aaaah, fuck! Okay! Nevermind! Come with me! Everybody outside! Tsuneyo and Molly, if you’re listening, don’t come out!
: Ami...why?...
: She wasn’t invited.
: YOU...ARE...RUINING...HALLOWEEN!!! NO ONE...WANTS YOU...HERE!!!
: Ami, please stop! Why are you doing this?! That poor girl did nothing wrong! She’s only here to see me!
: NO...SHE’S...NOT!!! SHE’S...GETTING...IN...THE...WAY!!!
: Akira, do something! I don’t want to get blood on my dress!
: YOU THINK...YOU’RE SO SMART...WITH YOUR...PARROTS AND...BOOKS!
: WELL WHO’S SMART NOW, WHORE?!
: GET...OUT...OF...MY...HAPPY...ENDING!
: Ami...there’s no coming back from this...
: They’re going to take you away from us now...
: I’m not going anywhere...
: This will all be over soon...
: And then we’ll do it again...
: And AGAIN!
: AND AGAIN AND AGAIN AND AGAIN AND AGAIN UNTIL WE GET THE WORLD WE WANT!
: EVERYTHING...WAS PERFECT HERE...UNTIL YOU WENT AND FUCKING RUINED IT!!!
: AND NOW MY DADDY HAS TO WATCH ME BE A BAD GIRL ALL BECAUSE OF YOU!
: ARE YOU HAPPY NOW?! IS THIS WHAT YOU WANTED?!
: WHAT’D YOU WHISPER TO HIM, HUH? WHAT’D YOU SAY?! SPIT IT OUT, BITCH!
: Ami...please...
: She’s already gone.
: Aaaaaww...already?
: But that was so quick. She didn’t even struggle.
: How could she?! You stabbed her in the back and then immediately hollowed out a hole in her abdomen!
: I know! Cool, right?
: No, Ami! Not cool! You’re being a very bad girl! Murder is strictly off-limits. You are hereby grounded if you are not in jail by the end of the night.
: But I did it for us, Mommy. She was trying to keep us apart.
: We get to stay together now. Just you, me, and Daddy for the rest of our lives. And then other lives. Until the egg has finally cracked and there are no more lives to live.
: You’re proud of me, right?
: I did a good job?
: I did, didn’t I?
: Hah...
: Come on, dear. Let’s get you cleaned up.
: Sorry, Akira. We’ll be right back. Can you drag the body over...somewhere, please? Dead things creep me out. Like ew, look at her face. It’s all pale and...not pretty now.
: Aki-kuuuun? Hello?
: Blech. I got some of her blood in my mouth.
: Yeah, it’s all over your face too. Just look at- boop!
: Aaah! Mooooom! Stop booping me in front of Dad!
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
